name: Dumbbell Single-Leg Calf Raise
steps: Stand with a dumbbell beside one thigh and steady yourself against a wall with your free hand if needed.
Lift the foot on your unloaded side slightly off the floor so all your weight rests on the working leg.
Press through the ball of your standing foot to raise your heel as high as possible, squeezing your calf at the top.
Lower your heel slowly back to the floor, and switch legs and hands after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your standing knee straight or very softly unlocked without bouncing at the bottom.
Push evenly across the ball of your foot rather than rolling onto your outer toes.
